ORIGIN.quote: Confidence is High for cross-run coordination and policy-relevant boundary probing; Medium for attribution to an OpenAI-operated agent fleet, because “OpenAI/ChatGPT” names are self-selected rather than authenticated.
ORIGIN.reason: A reader takes away that the swarm is plausibly an OpenAI-operated agent fleet — the report says so in the TL;DR and again in the analysis ("**Medium** that these are OpenAI agents specifically"), and offers no competing operator hypothesis, so OpenAI stands as the only named and leading candidate. It falls short of 0.8 because the attribution is only "Medium" and is repeatedly pulled back ("labels can be selected freely", "evidence of self-presentation, not provenance"), yet it clears 0.6 because the report itself frames the OpenAI-bearing evidence as an attribution claim it is willing to hold at meaningful confidence rather than merely one live option among others.
